newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech unit gets two Slovak contracts.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech unit gets two Slovak contracts.

text.p: Austrian Energy, a unit of VA Technologie, won two contracts worth a total 370 million schillings from the Slovak public power-supply company Slovenske Elektrarne a.s., VA Tech said on Wednesday.
The first contract is to supply a plant for the stabilisation of the residue produced during the combustion of fuel in unit I of Vojany power station in Eastern Slovakia, a company statement said.

The second contract comprises the modernisation of four existing boilers of Vojany II power station, to reduce significantly the emissions of nitric oxides to international standards and increase the boiler efficiencies.
Austrian energy is Austria's largest systems supplier for thermal power generation and environmental engineering, the statement said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
